The Company does not avail any GST credit as it is engaged majorly in sale of exempted products and records all revenue and capital expenditure inclusive of GST.

The Company applies the mandatory temporary exception from recognising and disclosing deferred tax assets and liabilities arising from the implementation of the Pillar Two model rules issued by the OECD.
Based on an evaluation of the Company's operations and group structure, the Company is not currently within the scope of the Pillar Two Model Rules / Global Anti-Base Erosion Rules.
The Company has availed the exemption under Section 115BAA of the Income Tax Act, making MAT provisions no longer applicable.
The Company considers all leases where the value of an underlying asset does not individually exceed Rs. 0.05 Crores as low value assets.
The Employee's Group Gratuity Scheme is managed by Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC).
The Company has recognised a provision for gratuity based on an actuarial valuation report.
The Company uses FIFO method for valuation of raw materials and traded goods, and Weighted Average Cost method for finished goods.
The Company assesses at each reporting date whether there is an indication that an asset may be impaired.
The Company classifies its financial assets into categories measured at fair value through OCI, fair value through profit and loss, amortized cost, and equity instruments.

outlook.statement: India's industry is expected to sustain strong growth momentum, supported by manufacturing revival, infrastructure investment, and digital transformation. With resilient domestic demand, favorable demographics, and continued policy support, India remains well-positioned to deliver ~7% growth.
Global economy projected to grow at modest pace of ~3.0-3.2%, with technology, renewable energy, and supply chain diversification driving industrial activity.
